about.name: Coach Raymond Cross
about.title: Head Football Coach
about.bio: Coach Raymond Cross has been shaping quarterbacks and football minds in the Coastal Georgia region for nearly two decades. A former college quarterback himself, Coach Cross brings a depth of offensive knowledge — and a storytelling patience — that is rare in private football training. His athletes don't just learn plays; they learn the game.

hero.headline: The Game Within the Game
hero.subline: Quarterback development and football IQ coaching for athletes who want to think like coaches.

services.title: Film & Football IQ

faq.question: What age do you start working with QBs?
faq.answer: I work with quarterbacks as young as 8. Early development focuses on mechanics, grip, and building a love for the position before introducing complexity.

faq.question: How long before I see improvement?
faq.answer: Most athletes see meaningful mechanical improvement within 6-8 sessions. Football IQ development is a longer process — but athletes typically report better pre-snap reads within 4-6 weeks of film sessions.

faq.question: Do you offer group sessions?
faq.answer: Limited QB group sessions (2-3 athletes) available. Most of my work is 1-on-1. The QB position rewards individual attention more than any other.
